{{Top|leg}}
A '''Tirrith restraining globe''' was a type of cage [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mils Giel]] used to contain his mutated [[Tirrith]].<ref name="bw">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040603behebothmain|text=Beheboth: Blood and Water|int=Beheboth: Blood and Water}}</ref>

It was created from the casing and filtration system of a [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]] which acted as a base. It hovered on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] scavenged from a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]]. To contain the Tirrith, a translucent pinkish ball of hermetically sealed [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] is placed on top of the base. The vents that release volatile gas are located on each globe's base. An electric prod powered by a small [[Vuvritech 44 generator]] bolted onto the side ensured that the Tirrith are kept agitated.<ref name="bw" />
